# Flat inventory of every known .agentic/ path-construction site fixed by
# the DS-171 repo-root anchoring change (Unit 1). One entry per line
# (comments and blank lines ignored). This is the coverage-diff source of
# truth for bin/tests/test_agentic_site_inventory_coverage.py: that test
# re-derives a deliberately OVERINCLUSIVE candidate list of `.agentic`
# path-construction lines across hooks/ (recursive) and bin/ (recursive),
# and asserts every candidate appears here. A new uninventoried .agentic-
# constructing line fails CI naming the offending line, closing the gap
# where a future hook silently reintroduces cwd-relative .agentic/ writes.
#
# ROUND-2 REWORK (adversarial review Major 4): entries are keyed by
# `path::normalized-snippet[#N]`, NOT `path:line`. A line-number key is
# defeated by ordinary editing - inserting one unrelated comment line
# anywhere above a site reindexes every entry below it, and the standard
# response (bulk regeneration) silently absorbs a genuinely new
# un-anchored site added in the same edit. A content key only changes when
# the site's OWN line changes. `#N` (N = 1-based occurrence index within
# the file) disambiguates the 2nd+ occurrence of an identical normalized
# snippet in one file.
#
# Entries below are MECHANICALLY GENERATED to match the scanner's own
# candidate output exactly (bin/tests/test_agentic_site_inventory_coverage
# .py's _find_candidates()) - do not hand-edit; regenerate via that
# function after any edit that changes a site's line content. The three
# resolver modules themselves (hooks/lib/repo-root.js, hooks/lib/
# repo_root.py, hooks/lib/repo-root.sh) are EXCLUDED - they are what does
# the resolving, not a site to resolve. Also excluded: HOME-scoped sites
# (never anchored to a project's repo root by design - e.g. ~/.agentic/
# constants) and a short list of exclusively operator-invoked CLIs (see
# EXCLUDED_FILES in the scanner) whose Path.cwd()/os.getcwd() correctly
# reflects wherever the human ran them from, not the harness-payload-cwd-
# drift bug class this ticket fixes.
#
# The scanner is DELIBERATELY OVERINCLUSIVE by design (it also matches
# comments, docstrings, and message-string concatenation that merely
# mention ".agentic" - e.g. context-rollup.js's log-message string
# building, or state-mark.js's JSDoc examples). Each such entry below has
# been reviewed and confirmed harmless (not a real path-construction
# site), not silently accepted.
